scripts.dev: WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh) && export WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET && astro dev
scripts.preview: WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh) && export WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET && astro preview
scripts.card:dev: WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh) && export WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET && astro dev --config card.config.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh) && export WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:changed: WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh) && export WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET && playwright test --only-changed
scripts.test:e2e:ui: WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh) && export WORKTREE_PORT_OFFSET && playwright test --ui
scripts.screenshot: PREVIEW_PORT=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh 4321) && export PREVIEW_PORT && bash scripts/screenshot.sh
scripts.readme-screenshot: PREVIEW_PORT=$(bash scripts/worktree-port.sh 4321) && export PREVIEW_PORT && bash scripts/readme-screenshot.sh
